rationale: The raw SOI localizes two current-period debt rows with footnote (17): Pigments Services, Inc. and CFCo LLC (Benefytt Technologies, Inc.). The filing separately reports 0.1% of assets on non-accrual at amortized cost for 2023, which corroborates nonzero non-accrual exposure. The defect is an extraction gap: the source-level nonaccrual status is not preserved in the normalized holdings surface.
